screen.payoff: Chat corrects her and she snaps out of the bit: 'It's an alligator. Shut up! You're an alligator!'

clips.header: He Just Wanted to Pet the Big Cat

screen.setup: Parked at a mansion, he spots a big cat in the garden and walks over: 'Wait, can I pet them?'
screen.payoff: It pounces and mauls him ('he's mauling me!'), he scrambles back to the car and apologises to it: 'Okay! I'm sorry!'
screen.uncertainty: VOD context read: after the clip he just drives off. Red damage tint during the maul, no visible gore. Facecam small top-right; full frame kept.
